               The RmmMeasurementDescriptorData structure contains data structure used to calculate the contribution to the

       Name                 Byte offset       Type                                    Description
       desc_type            0x0               Bits8                                   Measurement descriptor type, value 0x0
       len                  0x8               UInt64                                  Length of this data structure in bytes
       rim                  0x10              RmmRealmMeasurement                     Current RIM value
       ipa                  0x50              Address                                 IPA at which the DATA Granule is mapped in
                                                                                      the Realm
       flags                0x58              RmmDataFlags                            Flags provided by Host
       content              0x60              RmmRealmMeasurement                     Hash of contents of DATA Granule, or zero if

    pub len: UInt64,
    pub rim: RmmRealmMeasurement,

    pub content: RmmRealmMeasurement,
